$Comment: A pair of one element's essence, the element picked at random: the one list of element essences the
Mastery Trainer's content pays. Mmo_Mastery_Focus_Materials.json draws it as one of its two outcomes
(the Trainer's Due and the Master's lessons pay that table), and the Essence Infusion offer in the
bounty pack (ShopEntries/MMOSkillTree/Shop_Convert_Mastery_Point.json there) pays this table straight.
The Pool draws once, every entry equally likely. Add an element with one more entry (its Weight beside
the others sets how often it comes up), change Count to pay more or less of it, or ship a file that names
this table in ContributesTo to add an entry from another pack.
